title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent tool-calling examples (Python/TypeScript), and quickstart docs. This PR adds curated templates for common RAG patterns (single-doc retrieval, multi-doc prioritization, streaming retrieval), opinionated agent examples demonstrating tool-calling (search, calendar, and function invocation), and updates the docs site quickstarts and examples index. Motivation: provide developers with tested, copy-pasteable examples to reduce onboarding time and reduce support load (linked Linear items ENG-5123, PM-210). Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and YAML examples - [x] Add Python and TypeScript agent tool-calling samples - [x] Update docs site quickstarts and examples index - [x] Add smoke tests for examples - [x] Update docs sidebar and release notes
commits: Add RAG templates and base YAMLs
Add Python agent tool-calling example and README
Add TypeScript agent example and CI smoke test
Docs: wire examples into quickstarts and update sidebar
